world.name: exorcism complete
world.description: The gate to the Land of the Living Dead stands open.

world.name: Entrance to Hades
world.description: You are at the edge of a large chasm filled with heavy mist. The chasm can only be crossed via a rickety wooden bridge, which stands to the west of where you are. In the distance you can see a large gate, over which a string of lights is strung. The gates are open, but strange guttural chanting can be heard from within, and it does not sound like it would be wise to enter.

overrides.blockedText: Some invisible force prevents you from passing through the gate.

world.name: Land of the Dead
world.description: You have entered the Land of the Living Dead. Thousands of lost souls can be heard weeping and moaning. In the corner are stacked the remains of dozens of previous adventurers less fortunate than yourself. A passage exits to the north.

children.name: crystal skull
children.description: A skull of the clearest crystal, gleaming coldly.

world.name: Altar
world.description: This is the south end of a large temple. In front of you is what appears to be an altar. In one corner is a small hole in the floor which leads into darkness. You probably could not get back up it.

children.name: altar
children.description: A great stone altar, its surface worn by centuries of prayer.

say.text: From the distance the sound of a lone trumpet is heard. The room becomes very bright and you feel disembodied. In a moment, the brightness fades and you find yourself rising as if from a long sleep, deep in the woods. In the distance you can faintly hear a songbird and the sounds of the forest.
A feeling of peace settles over you. When it passes, you are somewhere else entirely.

world.name: death: the adventurer rises as a spirit

say.text: As you take your last breath, you feel relieved of your burdens. The feeling passes as you find yourself before the gates of Hell, where the spirits jeer at you and deny you entry. Your senses are disturbed. The objects in the dungeon appear indistinct, bleached of color, even unreal.

endsGame.text: You clearly are a suicidal maniac. We don't allow psychotics in the cave, since they may harm other adventurers. Your remains will be installed in the Land of the Living Dead, where your fellow adventurers may gloat over them.
